**Breaking News: Modibo Niakate Joins Cleveland State Vikings Men's Basketball Team**

Cleveland, OH - In a move that is set to shake up the college basketball landscape, Modibo Niakate, a talented young basketball player, has officially joined the Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team. According to sources close to the team, Niakate, a highly sought-after recruit, has committed to playing for the Vikings in the upcoming season. This news comes as a major coup for the Cleveland State program, which has been working to rebuild its roster and return to prominence in the Horizon League. "We are thrilled to welcome Modibo to our Viking family," said Cleveland State head coach, Dennis Felton. "He brings a level of athleticism and skill that will undoubtedly make an immediate impact on our team. We're excited to see him take the court and contribute to our success." Niakate, a 6'8" forward, is known for his versatility and ability to score from both inside and outside the paint. He averaged 18 points and 7 rebounds per game in his senior season at high school, earning him All-State honors and attracting the attention of college scouts from across the country. "Modibo is a tremendous addition to our program," said Cleveland State athletic director, Scott Garrett. "He's a talented player who fits perfectly into our system and will help us compete at a high level in the Horizon League. We're looking forward to seeing him develop and grow as a player over the next few years." According to data from the NCAA, the Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team has struggled in recent years, finishing with a sub-.500 record in three of the last four seasons. However, with the addition of Niakate and other talented recruits, the team is poised to make a significant turnaround in the upcoming season. "Modibo's commitment is a huge step forward for our program," said Felton. "We're building a team that will compete for championships and make our fans proud. We're excited to get started and see what the future holds." With Niakate on board, the Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team is gearing up for a season that promises to be filled with excitement and promise. Stay tuned for more updates on this developing story.
